entries.summary: Added `localStorage.member.extraEnv` for per-Cluster member environment overrides; additions and updates reconcile on existing DaemonSets without deleting undeclared custom variables.
upgradeNotes: **Removing custom variables:** remove declarations from `localStorage.member.extraEnv` and manually delete retained entries from the member DaemonSet.

entries.summary: Migration image defaults change `v1.0.4-01` → `v1.2.0` for directory-symlink SFTP errors; `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.version` selects JuiceFS (default `1.2.0`), requiring compatible Local Storage and migration images.
upgradeNotes: **Migration adopters:** select a published [companion-compatible](https://github.com/hwameistor/hwameistor/pull/1869) `localStorage.member.tag` and set `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.tag=v1.2.0`; existing Jobs retain their original templates.
**Special-file migrations:** avoid `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.version=1.4.1`; it skips devices, sockets, FIFOs and OverlayFS whiteouts even with checks.

entries.summary: Local Storage migration checks default `false` → `true` via `localStorage.migrate.check`; reconciliation updates `--migrate-check` on new and existing member DaemonSets.
upgradeNotes: **Checks intentionally disabled:** set `localStorage.migrate.check=false` to retain disabled verification.

excluded.reason: Routine maintenance-branch CI routing and checkout updates; no application runtime changes.
